newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - June 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - June 4.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Deputy Minister of Finance G.L. Peiris says improved corporate results now flowing out will lead to greater employment and reduced cost of living.
It is important to increase bus fares annually in line with prices in other areas to provide better service to passengers, says Srimani Athulathmudali, Minister of Transport.
Main opposition United National party MPs vow to protest against government plans to build a coal power plant north of Colombo.
Sinhalese civillians in Omanthai, recently captured by troops of Operation Jaya Sikuru, condemn alleged looting of houses by police, sources say.
Policeman injured in Monday's shooting at Valachchenai incident, where the LTTE attacked a police patrol, given refuge by Tamil family in area, say sources in the east.
